title: Revoke local sign-in access
scope: Expire this user’s existing Paperclip sessions and revoke their personal Board API keys across this instance. Credentials are not displayed.
warning: This does not disable future login, change organization membership, revoke IdP or connector tokens, or cancel running tasks. For offboarding, first disable IdP access and suspend memberships.
confirm: Type the exact target user ID to confirm
uncertain: The outcome is not confirmed. Retry the same request ID to retrieve its receipt; do not assume nothing happened.
storageFailed: This browser could not save the request ID. Copy it before leaving to avoid creating a new request accidentally.
historyFailed: Unable to load receipts. Refresh before interpreting the result.
